instruction.text: Convert the simple present verbs into the progressive present form.

hint.text:
The present progressive form is used to describe things that are happening right now. They have an -ing ending.
For example: “I am dancing”.
hint.sound:
The present progressive form is used to describe things that are happening right now. They have an i n g ending.
For example: “I am dancing”.

hint.text:
For verbs that end on a silent -e, you drop the -e before adding the ending -ing.
For example: take → taking
